item.title: Travis Scott Watches Drake’s Anita Max Win Tour via FaceTime—Concerts Will Never Be the Same
item.description: Ok… it’s happening. The dystopia is REAL. TRAVIS SCOTT—the man who just sold out SoFi Stadium and MetLife Stadium like it was a 7-Eleven on a Tuesday—decided that actually showing up to see Drake perform in Melbourne was too much effort.

item.title: DRAMA ALERT: Kanye West & Bianca Censori Divorce? Rep Shuts Down Rumors
item.description: Welp, here we go again—Kanye & Bianca’s divorce rumors have entered the chat—like an unkillable cockroach or an NSYNC reunion rumor that never actually happens. Look, the tabloids swore this time was for real: The Daily Mail and TMZ were all “OMG IT’S OVER”, acting like they had insider knowledge straight from Bianca’s group chat.

item.title: JAY-Z & Diddy’s Rape Lawsuit Dismissed: Accuser Drops Case Amid Inconsistencies
item.description: Okay okay okay—this is actually HILARIOUS. one minute there’s a lawsuit against jay-z (aka shawn “i don’t do this nonsense” carter) and diddy (aka sean “please ignore my 40+ other lawsuits” combs) for raping a 13-year-old back in 2000… and then BOOM—the whole thing vanishes faster than a tamagotchi you forgot to feed.

item.title: 6ix9ine Sparks Outrage After Mocking King Von Over Coffin Prank
item.description: LOL, good luck making sense of this one. Just when you thought Tekashi 6ix9ine had exhausted every possible way to troll a dead man, the universe—or maybe just two incredibly bored people with way too much free time—dropped a whole damn coffin at his house.
